common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Cyber insurance retrenchment
notable.line: Major European cyber-insurers sharply reprice or suspend coverage for municipal utilities and hospitals after autumn pre-positioning disclosures, forcing emergency state backstops.

notable.title: Datacentre pause
notable.line: A US hyperscaler freezes or delays planned EU data-centre expansion after gigafactory site fights over grid connections and priority power spill into public disputes over water and electricity prices.

notable.title: Hyperscaler pause eu build
notable.line: A major US hyperscaler publicly pauses two planned EU data-centre expansions, citing grid-connection delays and power pricing, fuelling press narrative that gigafactory site rivalry is deterring private build-out.

notable.title: Memory substrate squeeze
notable.line: A non-US, non-China supplier imposes temporary export licensing on a critical AI hardware input such as high-bandwidth memory or advanced substrates, citing domestic demand, spiking EU gigafactory cost estimates and delaying site decisions.
